channel.description: Stay updated on the latest news and events happening in the RPI community.

item.title: Writing Lab Fall Workshop Series
item.description: The Writing Lab at the Student Success Center is offering four workshops this fall, open to all undergraduate and graduate students. Two sessions focus on graduate school application writing, one addresses the use of AI in academic writing, and one covers oral presentation skills. All sessions are free and open to the RPI community. Workshops are held at the Student Success Center, Folsom Library, 1st Floor from 3-4 p.m.

item.description: Date: Monday, September 14, 2026 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM - This special webinar series is designed for master’s students from all academic backgrounds. Daily webinars on the following topics: September 14: 3 mistakes master’s students must avoid in their job search, September 15: The role of recruiters in the hiring process, September 16: How to build a network when you don’t have one, September 17: Strategic resume writing for master’s students, September 18: Career advice for international students…

item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:30 PM - Learn the basics of correct thesis organization and format, appropriate paper attribution and reference citation styles—plus a review of the most commonly found mistakes and ways to avoid them. item.description: The RPI Counseling Center invites students to meet with a counselor without a formal appointment, during designated drop-in hours. There are drop-in hours available every weekday when classes are in session. Academy Hall Suite 4200.

item.title: DCC–JEC Upper Deck Walkway Closure
item.description: Beginning Monday, September 14, the upper deck walkway between Darrin Communications Center (DCC) and Jonsson Engineering Center (JEC) will be temporarily closed for approximately three weeks while construction work is completed. Pedestrian detour routes will be reinstated during the closure. Please follow all posted signage and designated alternate routes and do not enter the construction area. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

item.title: RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series – September 2026
item.description: The RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series brings together faculty, researchers, and industry partners to share ideas, highlight collaborations, and advance semiconductor and microelectronics innovation. The seminar on September 15th, at the Albany NanoTech Complex, features Rena Huang (RPI) and Amit Dikshit (AIM Photonics) in two 45-min talks and a networking break. Faculty and students are invited, registration is required, transportation is possible. Follow link for more information.
item.author: Community

item.title: 9/11 Memorial Stair Run at The Approach
item.description: Join us on Friday, September 11, 2026, at The Approach at RPI for a 9/11 Memorial Stair Run/Walk. Everyone is welcome to participate! Participants may run, walk, or ruck the stairs. This event honors the first responders who climbed the stairs of the World Trade Center on September 11, 2001. As we take on the stairs ourselves, we remember their courage, sacrifice, and selfless service.
item.author: Community

item.title: Dean Liad Wagman to Lead Free International Webinar on Responsible AI in Research
item.description: On Friday, September 11, 10 to 11 a.m. ET, Liad Wagman, Dean of the RPI Lally School of Management, will lead a free webinar hosted by AACSB International, the global accrediting body for business schools, on how schools are moving from AI policy to daily practice. The session covers research integrity, teaching and assessment, and administration and governance, with practical approaches relevant beyond business schools. Register today!

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Seminar- “RPI MAX: Setting Goals and Reviewing Results”
item.description: This seminar will establish the positive effect of transforming the traditional role of planner and evaluator solely from the people-leader to a shared responsibility between leader and direct report. Leaders will experience how to develop and use effective SMART goals to help them, and their employees track progress and accurately evaluate outcomes. In addition, the fundamentals of an impactful performance discussion and the three phased approach of RPI MAX will be explored.
